name: Mr. Baretto's House, Macao
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A street view looking past the wall and steps of S. Lourenço Church, Macau, with a group of Chinese figures and cattle at the foot of the steps, and a crucifix by the parapet above.
